Golf Channel's flagship news program, the nightly "Golf Central" presents highlights from the major golf tours and world events, plus reports and features from tournament sites.

Final Round | The TOUR Championship concludes with the final round at East Lake Golf Club in Atlanta. The field completes 72 holes of stroke play, with the lowest cumulative score claiming the TOUR Championship and FedExCup titles with a huge chunk from the purse.
